primer: Uber runs a global ride and delivery network with $59.82B in Q3 2026 Gross Bookings and $10.42B in TTM FCF [31, 32]. Core quality earns COMPOUNDER_PASS with PASS_WITH_WATCH for $17.1B in pending deals, +49% higher debt, $1.5B UK VAT cash, and robotaxis [31, 33]. Deducting $2.15B stock pay, $7.67B net debt, $1.5B UK VAT cash, and $10.65B deal outlays puts shares at 17.12x normalized EV/(FCF-SBC). Our SBC-adjusted DCF sets Base fair value at $75.00 ($70.14 standalone ex-M&A FCF) against $45.00 Bear ($41.78 stressed) and $108.00 Bull ($72.60 EV). At $63.47 in Stage 4 (CAP_REJECTED), equity is REJECTED (TIER_0; TREND, CASH_FLOW) and we mandate EXIT_IMMEDIATELY on the 5 open Dec 2027 LEAPS.
verdict_rule_summary: STAGE_4 (CAP_REJECTED) and M&A/cash-flow friction force REJECTED (TIER_0); $61.24–$63.10 ($60.96 stop) is strictly a historical reference below the $63.00 LEAPS floor (0.0% bids until Stage 1 base + Stage 2 reclaim >$73.50).
sizing_table_takeaway: At $75,110.60 US net worth ($2,540.35 cash, 3.38% vs. 22.0% Downtrend floor), UBER carries 0.0% equity allocation under REJECTED (TIER_0) while existing Dec 2027 LEAPS carry EXIT_IMMEDIATELY (CLOSE_INTO_CASH) to salvage ~$820–$1,020.
